title: Area of Triangle Using Coordinates — Coordinate Geometry
hook: Let's explore Area of Triangle Using Coordinates from the chapter on Coordinate Geometry. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Area of Triangle Using Coordinates Area of triangle with vertices (x₁,y₁), (x₂,y₂), (x₃,y₃) = ½|x₁(y₂−y₃) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₁−y₂)|. If area = 0, points are collinear. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Area = ½|x₁(y₂−y₃) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₁−y₂)|
💡 Absolute value ensures area is always positive
💡 If area = 0, the three points are collinear (lie on same line)
💡 Can extend to find area of quadrilateral by dividing into triangles
